title: Too Many Tornadoes
description: This modpack adds a lot of stuff with the PMWeather mod, check desc for more info.
body:
World & Exploration

This modpack adds 100+ vanilla-friendly biomes, realistic terrain, continents, cars, rustic aircraft, realistic tornadoes, temperature, and thirst. It also has journey map and waystones.

Multiplayer

This modpack has the essential mod so you can play with your friends at any time. There is world host as an alternative if you don't like essential or if it doesn't work.

Combat

It has better combat which replaces normal java combat with Minecraft Dungeons Combat. Also when you attack it shows a small number of how much HP that did to your target (from damage numbers mod)

Building

Bedrock bridging and no block place delay. I also added schematics.

Detection & Radar

This pack also has EAS and a better radar.

Villages & NPCs

This modpack upgrades villagers and villages with better villages, guard villagers, and secret traitors in villages. Also don't steal from villagers, the guards won't be happy...

Respawning & Death Mechanics

Respawning isn't instant +HP -Hunger, you now respawn with half health and at least a quarter of energy left. Also now deaths are undertale lol.

_This modpack should by default have low settings on PMWeather._
_This modpack is based of [JEOM](https://modrinth.com/modpack/jeom) so thanks to the creator of that_

**EAS RADAR POLYGONS DO NOT WORK DUE TO THE BETTER RADAR MOD**

**ON LOW-END DEVICES YOU WILL PROBABLY LAG WITH HIGH SETTINGS**

If you want some schematics, I recommend this [Github Page](https://github.com/IfNullThenVoid/minecraft-litematica-schematics) I do not own that Page

I recommend 4 GB- 6 GB of RAM allocated to Minecraft. If you have 16 GB of RAM on your computer, I recommend allowcating 6 GB. If you only have 8 GB, allocate 4 GB. I strongly do not recommend using this modpack with less then 4 GB of memory allowcated or with less than 8 GB of total RAM. You must have a decent computer to run this modpack.

Part of the description was sorted by AI
